notes.title: Release Notes for 2024.10.19
notes.content:
This update improves the game experience and addresses feedback.

[list]
[*] Improved click detection.
[*] Added new default playlist. The old playlist is available in settings.
[*] All available moves are now shown instead of showing only units that can be captured.
[*] Added cheat sheet. A button to display is shown after the first move.
[*] Removed unused menu setting.
[*] Display “Red wins” or “Black wins” instead of "You Win" or "You Lose".
[*] Animated piece flips and movement.
[*] Removed AI generated menu background image and replaced with professional art used in Steam store and library.
[*] Display victory conditions required to win.
[*] Fixed defect where tooltip did not appear over a piece when hovering more than once in a row.
[*] Upgraded to latest major version of game engine which contains defect fixes and performance optimizations.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed defect where tooltip did not appear over a piece when hovering more than once in a row.

notes.title: Release Notes for 2024.08.27
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Add option 'Show Tooltips' which displays the name of the piece on hover. Enabled by default.
[*] Add option 'Show Potential Captures' which displays which pieces can be captured by the selected piece. Enabled by default.
[*] Add compatibility launch option. The compatibility launch option uses the opengl rendering driver.
[*] Add link to Discord invite and X account.
[*] Add logic to prevent AI from making repetitive moves.
[/olist]
